title: ci(scaffold-e2e): the skills-boundary step expects only objectstack-* skills, so every create-objectstack PR goes red since the objectui skill joined skills/ (#26097)
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** Every PR that touches `packages/create-objectstack/**` (the workflow's `paths` filter) now shows a red `Scaffold E2E · Scaffold with repo dist`. The diff is never the cause. The check is not required, so the merge isn't blocked, but a red row a reviewer has to explain away on every scaffold PR trains people to ignore the one check that guards the "only curated skills ship to users" boundary.

**Reader who acts.** The seat that owns `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`. This is Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`), so it needs a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.

## Measured

- PR #26198 at `23f2dea480`, job 121659327584. The step "Skills boundary: only the curated skills/ catalog installs" logs `installed` = the ten `objectstack-*` skills plus `objectui`, `expected` = the ten `objectstack-*` skills, then `::error::scaffolded skill set != curated skills/ catalog`.
- `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml:255` on `main`: `expected=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/skills" && ls -d objectstack-*/ | tr -d '/' | sort)`.
- #26097 (merged 2026-10-26, decision C) moved the `objectui` skill bundle into root `skills/` as a curated skill. `ls skills` on `main` lists `objectui` beside the `objectstack-*` ten.
- The job is `if: github.event_name != 'schedule'`, so the nightly run never shows it. It surfaces only on scaffold PRs.

## Wanted

Build `expected` from the curated catalog as it now stands (every skill directory under `skills/`, or an explicit allow-list that names `objectui`), keeping the step's purpose: fail when an internal skill leaks or a curated one is missing. Pin the new rule with whatever self-test the workflow's scripts carry. ⛔ Don't drop or weaken the boundary step.

## Acceptance

- `Scaffold with repo dist` is green on a PR that touches `packages/create-objectstack/**` and changes no skill.
- A negative control (an extra non-curated skill directory) still fails the step.

Related: #26097, PR #26198, #26095.
